title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
abstract: arXiv:2610.41754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. translated_title: 基于显式规则归纳的多模态上下文学习
translated_abstract: 多模态上下文学习（MICL）的一个核心挑战来自于那些在缺乏上下文时定义不明确的任务，这些任务需要从示例中揭示其潜在的规则。现有方法主要将MICL视为直接的输入-输出映射，忽视了显式归纳并对这些规则进行推理的重要性，从而限制了性能和可解释性。我们提出了ERIM（面向多模态上下文学习的显式规则归纳），这是一个统一的框架，通过显式归纳支配示例样本的潜在规则来增强MICL。利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力，ERIM构建了以规则为中心的MICL数据集，为规则归纳引入显式监督，并通过两阶段训练策略（结合混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习）对MLLM进行微调，使其能够执行显式规则归纳。大量实验显示出一致的（提升）……
tldr: ERIM提出了一个通过显式归纳示例中的潜在规则来增强多模态上下文学习的统一框架，并采用混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习相结合的两阶段策略微调多模态大语言模型，从而同时提升性能与可解释性。
en_tdlr: ERIM is a unified framework that enhances multimodal in-context learning by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstrations, fine-tuning MLLMs via a two-stage strategy combining mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to improve both performance and interpretability.
